conclusions.id: Hypernetwork improves all three paired runs.
conclusions.ood: Mean paper R² improves by 0.0152604, driven by seed 2; seeds 1 and 3 are worse. A stable advantage is not established.
conclusions.mechanism: Trained probes outperform controls, but decodability and a privileged teacher executor do not establish the mechanism used by the model.

limits: Three training seeds with one fixed teacher/split; min-max is not a confidence interval.
Connected+ reconstruction, 2048 episodes per bank; not an exact replication of the paper.
Complete configurations differ: vanilla width 128 / weight decay 0.1; hypernetwork width 64 / weight decay 0.
Decoder features differ: vanilla query-inclusive residual, hypernetwork context-only.
The untrained control repeats one fixed initialization per variant, not three independent control models.
Probes and executor diagnostics use final weights only; executor has access to known teacher modules.
